units.title: Generic shop onboarding wizard + controller fingerprint upload
units.scope: 60s sidecar provisioning; operator uploads controller fingerprint (FOCAS probe / OPC-UA browse / manual); auto-config of MS5 dialect emitter; first program emit within 1 hour of signup.

units.title: Video walkthroughs (3-5 min per machine family)
units.scope: Hurco mill, Okuma lathe, Mitsubishi WEDM, Multus mill-turn, Roku-Roku high-speed. Embedded in wizard at relevant steps.

units.title: CS health-score signal from MS11 telemetry
units.scope: Low feed-override usage, frequent SHA failures, no probe emission, high MS14 BLOCK rate, high MS17 disagreement rate → at-risk flag. CS dashboard surfaces trend per customer.

units.title: In-wizard FAQ from MS10 PDFs + expansion hooks
units.scope: Searchable FAQ surfaced from MS10 tribal store; contextual help per wizard step; expansion prompts ('you have a Multus B250IIW configured but unused — try lathe-mill').

units.title: Onboarding 30-day email cadence + in-app tooltips
units.scope: Day 1/7/14/30 email cadence with progressive disclosure; in-app tooltips for first-run; setup-sheet UX test (MS13) extended to onboarding flow.
